Project Title: Automated Financial Report Parsing and KPI Extraction using Pandas, PDFMiner, and Named Entity Recognition Models

Reference ID: ai-ml-ds-SrmZNuoOhMk

Filename: automated_financial_report_parsing_and_kpi_extraction.py

Short Description

This project automates the extraction of key performance indicators (KPIs) from financial reports in PDF format. It leverages PDFMiner for text extraction, applies Named Entity Recognition (NER) using pre-trained models to identify financial entities, and utilizes Pandas for data manipulation and analysis. The goal is to transform unstructured financial documents into structured data for further analysis.

Problem Domain

Financial analysis often requires parsing large volumes of unstructured reports to extract meaningful KPIs. Automating this process enhances efficiency and accuracy in financial data analysis.

Use Cases

  • Automated extraction of financial KPIs from annual reports.
  • Real-time analysis of financial documents for investment decisions.
  • Integration into financial dashboards for monitoring company performance.(nlp.johnsnowlabs.com)

  • Pandas: Data manipulation and analysis.
  • PDFMiner.six: PDF text extraction.
  • SpaCy: Natural Language Processing and NER.
  • Scikit-learn: Machine learning utilities.
  • Matplotlib: Data visualization.(Encord, products.documentprocessing.com)

Python Code

# automated_financial_report_parsing_and_kpi_extraction.py

import os
import re
from typing import List, Dict
import pandas as pd
from pdfminer.high_level import extract_text
import spacy
from spacy.tokens import Doc
from spacy.matcher import Matcher
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

class PDFParser:
    def __init__(self, file_path: str):
        self.file_path = file_path

    def extract_text(self) -> str:
        return extract_text(self.file_path)

class KPIExtractor:
    def __init__(self, nlp_model: str = "en_core_web_sm"):
        self.nlp = spacy.load(nlp_model)
        self.matcher = Matcher(self.nlp.vocab)
        self._define_patterns()

    def _define_patterns(self):
        patterns = [
            [{"LOWER": "revenue"}, {"IS_DIGIT": True}],
            [{"LOWER": "net"}, {"LOWER": "income"}, {"IS_DIGIT": True}],
            [{"LOWER": "operating"}, {"LOWER": "expenses"}, {"IS_DIGIT": True}],
        ]
        for pattern in patterns:
            self.matcher.add("KPI", [pattern])

    def extract_kpis(self, text: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
        doc = self.nlp(text)
        matches = self.matcher(doc)
        kpis = []
        for match_id, start, end in matches:
            span = doc[start:end]
            kpis.append({"kpi": span.text, "value": self._extract_value(span)})
        return kpis

    def _extract_value(self, span: Doc) -> str:
        for token in span:
            if token.like_num:
                return token.text
        return ""

class KPIAnalyzer:
    def __init__(self, kpis: List[Dict[str, str]]):
        self.df = pd.DataFrame(kpis)

    def clean_data(self):
        self.df.dropna(inplace=True)
        self.df['value'] = self.df['value'].apply(lambda x: float(re.sub(r'[^\d.]', '', x)))

    def visualize(self):
        self.df.groupby('kpi')['value'].mean().plot(kind='bar')
        plt.title("Average KPI Values")
        plt.ylabel("Value")
        plt.show()

def main():
    parser = PDFParser("financial_report.pdf")
    text = parser.extract_text()

    extractor = KPIExtractor()
    kpis = extractor.extract_kpis(text)

    analyzer = KPIAnalyzer(kpis)
    analyzer.clean_data()
    analyzer.visualize()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Advanced Functionalities Implemented

  • Custom Pattern Matching: Utilizes SpaCy's Matcher to identify KPIs based on defined patterns.
  • Dynamic Value Extraction: Extracts numerical values associated with KPIs, handling various formats.
  • Data Cleaning and Visualization: Processes extracted data for analysis and generates visual representations.

Future Enhancements

  • Integration with Financial Databases: Cross-reference extracted KPIs with existing financial data for validation.
  • Enhanced NER Models: Incorporate domain-specific NER models for improved accuracy.
  • Web Interface: Develop a user-friendly web application for uploading PDFs and viewing extracted data.(John Snow Labs)

This project serves as a comprehensive solution for automating the extraction and analysis of financial KPIs from unstructured documents, leveraging advanced NLP techniques and adhering to best practices in software design.
